decisions.reason: The prominent home-page launch signals a public commitment, and management has invested in the click-in mechanism, so escalation of commitment makes dropping unlikely.
Because it is close to the established offer and only briefly mentioned, management sees less public commitment but still persists due to sunk costs in the LED luminaire.
As a building block of the announced home-automation direction, the server box carries visible strategic commitment, so management keeps it and attributes any weak results to temporary factors.
The dedicated page and product family represent significant investment and central positioning, leading management to continue despite the lack of clear performance data.
